reports.title: INTERPARFUMS, INC. REPORTS 2026 THIRD QUARTER AND NINE-MONTH RESULTS;

lines: As shared last quarter, we are reinvesting the tariff refunds to support the strong momentum we are seeing in the United States market, drive our top-line growth and position the Company for a successful 2027; as such, we anticipate our full year 2026 A&P expenditures will approach our long-term target of approximately 21% of net sales.
The Company is increasing its 2026 sales outlook from $1.48 billion to $1.49 billion and maintaining EPS of $4.85.
EPS guidance for 2026 includes the expected effect of refunds already received associated with approximately $17.7 million of estimated IEEPA tariffs paid by the Company.
